title: AquaLava Survival
description: survive in lava and water but don't swim in lava in the overworld!
body:
Step into a completely new challenge in Minecraft with AquaLava Survival!

Survive only in water and lava.

In water, you can breathe normally anywhere, but lava is safe only in the Nether.

Step outside water or lava and you will start taking continuous ticking damage — be careful!

Discover new strategies: carefully build your paths, plan your routes, and test your skills in both liquids.

Perfect for hardcore players and custom maps seeking the ultimate survival challenge.

Features:

Water Breathing in water

Fire Resistance in lava (Nether only)

Continuous ticking damage when outside of water or lava

Compatible with Overworld, Nether, and custom maps

Can be combined with other challenges for the ultimate survival experience
